name: Jonathan
bio:
Jonathan was the son of the priest Abiathar. When David fled Jerusalem during Absalom's rebellion and sent Abiathar and Zadok back into the city with the ark, he arranged for Jonathan and Zadok's son Ahimaaz to stay behind with their fathers as runners, ready to carry word to David of anything David's spy Hushai learned inside Absalom's camp (2 Samuel 15:27-28, 36).

After Hushai's counsel defeated Ahithophel's, Jonathan and Ahimaaz waited at En Rogel, unable to risk being seen entering the city; a servant girl carried them word to warn David not to delay crossing the Jordan. A boy spotted them and told Absalom, forcing the two to hide in a well at a house in Bahurim, which a woman covered and spread grain over to conceal them while Absalom's men searched and gave up. Once the danger passed, Jonathan and Ahimaaz hurried to David with the warning, and David's entire company crossed the Jordan by morning light, escaping just in time (2 Samuel 17:17-22).
